zh.title: 歐盟航空安全局發布2026年安全報告
zh.summary: 歐盟航空安全局公佈2026年安全報告；2025年安全表現穩定
body: 歐盟航空安全局（EASA）公佈了2026年年度安全報告（ASR），分析2025年歐洲航空安全狀況並與過去10年數據比較。
報告指出，幾乎所有領域的致命事故和死亡人數均保持在過去10年平均水平或以下，顯示安全表現基本穩定或有所改善。
首次附帶的6頁簡要報告為商業航空、旋翼機和通用航空的關鍵數據和主要安全風險提供簡明格式。

en.title: EASA Publishes 2026 Safety Review
en.summary: EASA releases 2026 Safety Review; 2025 safety performance remains stable
body: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) published the 2026 Annual Safety Review (ASR), analyzing aviation safety in Europe during 2025 and comparing results with the previous 10 years.
The review indicates that the number of fatal accidents and fatalities remained at or below the 10-year average across almost all domains, suggesting stable or improved safety performance.
A new six-page summary accompanies the full review, presenting key data and leading safety risks for commercial air transport, rotorcraft, and general aviation in an accessible format.
